Subject: Request: Private deployment evidence and operator controls

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. As part of our procurement packet we need a short evidentiary response to a few items in your private deployment questionnaire. Can you provide the following by EOD Wednesday (PST)?

1) High-level operator separation documentation for on-prem installations (we need the operator boundary diagram and runbook excerpts showing separation of duties).

4) A compact capability matrix we can attach to our internal RFP binder that maps features to controls (e.g., KMS integration, telemetry retention, egress controls).

Also copying our third-party security assessor (James Li) who may ask a follow-up. If possible, can we schedule a 30-min technical sync Thursday morning PST?

Best,
Alex

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

Hi Alex / James — follow-up from our side. Per today’s internal alignment we’ve attached a compact evidence bundle and a short narrative addressing your three asks. Attachments below:

- redwood_private_capabilities_matrix_v2.xlsx (capabilities -> controls mapping)
- operator_boundary_diagram.pdf (anonymized diagram of operator vs control plane)
- patch_signature_process.md (high-level flow; includes KMS/HSM usage and signing keys rotation cadence)
- supplychain_sbom.zip (CycloneDX + SPDX sample for the release; redacted hashes)
- checksum_manifest.txt (SHA256 checksums for files in the bundle)

Key clarifications:
- We perform patch artifact signing using an HSM-backed key in our build pipeline. Keys rotate every 90 days; signatures are verified on ingest with a mandatory verification step before apply.
- Operator accounts for on-prem deployments are scoped to host maintenance; escalation requires separate ALM/identity provider accounts. We do not share operator privileged credentials across customers; audit logging is mandatory for all operator actions.
- SBOMs can be exported in CycloneDX or SPDX; we attached CycloneDX by default. No customer PII is included in the SBOM export.

We’ve also uploaded the same bundle to a shared Drive folder and linked it in the capabilities spreadsheet. If James needs the SBOM in a specific format or needs cryptographic verification artifacts (signed manifests, timestamped signatures), please let us know and Marcus will join the technical sync.

Confirming the 30-min technical sync tomorrow at 10:00 AM PST (invite attached). Looking forward to the call.

Best,
Kimberly Park
